item.title: Implement specified token bucket rate limiter
item.brief: Implement the rate limiter in ratelimit.py exactly as specified in SPEC.md. Cover TokenBucket validation, continuous fractional refill capped at capacity, injected monotonic clock behavior including backwards-clock handling, try_acquire and wait_time semantics and errors. Implement KeyedLimiter with independent per-key buckets, hashable keys, LRU eviction where both operations count as use, validation, and len(). Keep it standard-library-only. The existing test_ratelimit.py covers basics; ensure implementation handles the spec's additional edge cases. Commit the completed change. Do not modify unrelated files.

pr.body: Implemented TokenBucket with continuous fractional refill capped at capacity, monotonic clock rollback handling, validation, acquisition, and non-consuming wait_time. Implemented KeyedLimiter using independent per-key buckets and OrderedDict LRU eviction, counting both operations as use. Expanded test_ratelimit.py for refill, waits, validation, rollback, key behavior, and eviction. Checks: `python -m unittest -v` (9 passed), `python -m py_compile ratelimit.py test_ratelimit.py` (passed), `git diff --check` (passed). Standard library only; no known limitations.
